content.text:
Runtime clarification: browser specs import `frontend/tests/backend.ts`, which automatically starts the built frontend per worker on ports `4300 + workerIndex` and supplies a controlled API. No separately running server is needed for those tests.

Useful commands from the worktree:

```sh
npm --prefix frontend run check
npm --prefix frontend run build
cd frontend
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 npx playwright test tests/member-summary.spec.ts tests/entity-details.spec.ts
```

Install Chromium once with `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 npx playwright install chromium`.

For screenshots against the real Compose backend, README specifically recommends `docker compose up --build -d --no-deps frontend` from the worktree; this serves its frontend without recreating the shared backend/database. No files were changed.
